hero.h1: Every add to cart adds the right thing.

hero.clientLine: The merchant taps Approve on the fixes from their phone, before the campaign goes live.

pack.name: Store Check Agent Pack
pack.intro: Eight agents for the store. Every product and collection page, after every theme push.

agents.name: Add to Cart
agents.checks: Checks every add to cart button adds the right product and variant.
agents.finding: 'Add to cart' on /products/oak-table adds the walnut variant.

agents.name: Checkout Path
agents.checks: Walks product to checkout on desktop and phone.
agents.finding: Checkout button sits under the cookie banner on phone.

agents.name: Price Match
agents.checks: Checks prices on collection pages match the product page.
agents.finding: Oak Table is 899 on the collection page and 949 on its own page.

agents.name: Image Inspector
agents.checks: Finds missing, stretched or broken product images.

agents.name: Stock Labels
agents.checks: Finds 'In stock' badges on sold-out products.

agents.name: Offer Expiry
agents.checks: Finds promos and discount codes with a past end date.
agents.finding: Banner says 'Free shipping ends Sept 30.' Today is Oct 21.

agents.name: Tracking Check
agents.checks: Confirms analytics, pixel and tag manager fire through checkout.
agents.finding: Meta pixel fires on product pages but not on the thank-you page.

agents.name: Policy Links
agents.checks: Checks shipping, returns and privacy links work from every page.

buildYourOwn.input: Flag any product page with fewer than three photos.
buildYourOwn.finding: 28 products have one photo. The brief asks for three.

faq.q: Does it check stores behind a password?
faq.a: Yes. Agents check password-protected stores and unpublished themes.

faq.q: Does it work on WooCommerce and BigCommerce?
faq.a: Yes. Agents check the live store from the outside. One-click install exists for Shopify and WordPress.

faq.q: Can agents run after every theme push?
faq.a: Yes. Fire a webhook on publish. The agents rerun on the pages that changed.
